description: Create a website for a published app at {subdomain}.apppage.net, filled from its store listing (name, icon, screenshots, description, store buttons). Its privacy policy, terms, account deletion and support pages start empty: write them with set_page. Check the address with check_subdomain first.

app.description: Google Play: the package name (com.example.app) or its Play link. App Store: the numeric app id or its apps.apple.com link.

country.description: Optional two-letter store country the app is listed in, for App Store apps not in the US store.

subdomain.description: The site address: {subdomain}.apppage.net. 3-14 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

name: create_site
title: Create a site
